architecture.selection: campaign provisional; exact-head construction and GPU pilot required before main launch

training.oom_policy: halve micro batch and increase accumulation to preserve approximately the same token batch
training.precision_policy: bf16 must be explicitly supported; no silent fp16/fp32 substitution

minimum_campaign_topology.note: 48 GiB is a conservative pilot selection threshold, not a measured requirement

multi_gpu.reason: real NCCL canonical-model training is not yet campaign evidence and is unnecessary for the minimum ~100M campaign

checkpoint.100m_acceptance: GPU pilot must measure save+verify, reload, payload bytes and peak CUDA memory; main throughput projection includes checkpoint overhead

pretraining_metrics: generation smoke samples with exact checkpoint/tokenizer identity

qualification_gates.mechanism: existing D02 Real S0 Training workflow runs on every PR
qualification_gates.acceptance: exact campaign SHA; locked environment; real 40-step train evidence; no parent-head inheritance
995552-param exact D11 S2 model; real Trainer forward/backward/AdamW update; finite metrics; parameter change
qualification_gates.command: python tools/run_100m_campaign.py s2-probe --repo-root . --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --output evidence/campaign47-s2.json

qualification_gates.acceptance: 9999680-param exact D11 S3 model; real update; D05 checkpoint save/verify/reload; exact campaign SHA
qualification_gates.command: python tools/run_s3_10m_engineering_probe.py --repo-root . --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --output evidence/campaign47-s3.json --device cpu --precision fp32 --batch-size 1 --sequence-length 256 --optimizer-steps 1 --gradient-accumulation-steps 1 --checkpoint-every 1

qualification_gates.acceptance: exact 99797760-param construction and measured fp32 parameter tensor bytes
qualification_gates.command: python tools/run_100m_campaign.py s4-preflight --repo-root . --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --output evidence/campaign47-s4-preflight.json

qualification_gates.acceptance: real CUDA evidence provides preliminary end-to-end tokens/s including checkpoint work; cannot authorize main budget
real CUDA bf16 100M Trainer update; peak VRAM; checkpoint save/verify/reload; measured end-to-end tokens/s
qualification_gates.command: python tools/run_100m_campaign.py s4-gpu-pilot --repo-root . --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --provider-label PROVIDER --hardware-label GPU --hourly-cost-eur CURRENT_RATE --rate-evidence RATE_SOURCE --compute-class local_free --output evidence/campaign47-s4-gpu-pilot.json
qualification_gates.paid_variant_rule: change compute-class to paid only with explicit --authorize-paid-compute

qualification_gates.acceptance: all exact-head gates PASS; 32K BPE/corpus/evaluation identities frozen; 100M measured budget within cap; explicit paid authorization
qualification_gates.command: python tools/run_100m_campaign.py qualify --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --variant eur_2k --s2 EVIDENCE_S2 --s3 EVIDENCE_S3 --s4 EVIDENCE_S4 --pilot EVIDENCE_100M_GPU --tokenizer TOKENIZER_FREEZE --corpus CORPUS_FREEZE --evaluation EVALUATION_FREEZE --output qualification.json

eur_2k.intent: minimum serious approximately 20 optimized tokens per parameter run

eur_10k.intent: three independent approximately 30 optimized tokens per parameter replicas rather than unproven multi-GPU scale-out

budget_truth: No GPU throughput is prefilled. A 10M CUDA measurement is preliminary only. The main budget becomes authoritative only after the exact 100M CUDA pilot records end-to-end optimized tokens/s and current hourly rate evidence.
